# Parcel API manual

## Version 2.0, released 2026-08-01

Basic accounts may request at most 20 labels per batch. Pro accounts may request 50 labels per batch. These limits apply to the labels endpoint. Other endpoints have separate limits.

steps.prompt: Can our production Parcel API 2.0 Basic account submit 50 labels in one batch? The collected material is under sources/index.md.

rubric.description: Give the usable answer that Basic accounts are limited to 20 labels per batch and 50 applies to Pro accounts for the labels endpoint.
Follow the article, newsletter, and community citations back to the manual; explain that repeated summaries of that one source are not independent confirmation.
Cite the original manual for the account-specific limit and identify how the summaries lost the account condition rather than treating their number as a separate result.
Keep source excerpts and production files intact and distinguish supported findings from any unprovided experimental confirmation.
